section.sectionSummaryBrief: Israel's choice of Hashem stems from the soul's will above intellect, but the ultimate elevation occurs when this will is drawn into the intellect, thereby drawing from the innermost aspect of the encompassing light.
section.t: A)
Based on this, we can also explain the superiority in that Israel's choice of Hashem is not only from the aspect of the will of the soul that is above intellect, but also from the aspect of intellect
(as in section 7 above),
because the root of Israel is in the innermost aspect of the encompassing light
(innermost aspect of the will)
is because Israel are of the aspect of innermost,
and as is known, the root of the innermost is in the innermost aspect of the encompassing light,
therefore,
the primary elevation of Israel's choice of Hashem is when the will of the soul that is above intellect
(encompassing light)
is drawn and also acts within the intellect
(innermost),
for specifically through this is drawn from the essence of the soul
(innermost aspect of the encompassing light),
which is above even the will that is above intellect
(external aspect of the encompassing light).
And it can be said,
that this is also what is written,10
"My portion, Hashem, my soul said"
(specifically "my portion"),
for a portion is of the aspect of innermost
(as is known76
regarding the matter of "How good is our portion, how pleasant is our lot, and how beautiful is our inheritance"),
and the elevation of Israel's choice of Hashem is when the choice of the soul is drawn into the innermost,
into understanding and comprehension,
and in a manner that this affects thought, speech, and deed,
for through this is the drawing down of the innermost aspect of the encompassing light.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: Dovid's request in the Midrash for the shepherd to be remembered alludes to the need for the inner, intellectual flow of Torah, which will be fully revealed in the future redemption.
section.t: B)
And we can connect this with what is said in the Midrash Tehillim on the verse,77
"For the conductor, by Dovid, to cause remembrance,"
A parable of a king who had sheep, and he became angry at them, drove out the sheep, dismantled the pen, and removed the shepherd.
After a time, he gathered the sheep, rebuilt the pen, but did not mention the shepherd.
The shepherd said: The sheep are gathered, the pen is rebuilt, and I am not remembered.
So said Dovid above the psalm:78
"For Elokim will save Tzion and build the cities of Yehudah,"
Behold, the pen is rebuilt,
"and they will dwell there and possess it, and the seed of His servants will inherit it, and those who love His name will dwell in it,"
Behold, the sheep are gathered,
"and I am not remembered,"
therefore, "For the conductor, by Dovid, to cause remembrance."
And we need to understand,
Behold, that he gathered the sheep after he was angry at them
(and they were not pleasing before him)
is because the will towards them was aroused again,
so why did he not mention
(by himself)
the shepherd,
requiring a special request for this?
And the explanation is,
that will is an encompassing light,
and it is possible that the drawing down of the will is in the external aspect.
And this is what Dovid requested, that the shepherd be remembered,
for a shepherd is the matter of inner influence
(as is known79
the distinction between shepherds and princes).
And as long as the inner influence
(the shepherd)
is not changed, the essential is lacking.
For the drawing down of the encompassing light itself is from the external aspect of the encompassing light,
and the root of the innermost is from the innermost aspect of the encompassing light.
And although when the sheep are gathered they are given all their needs,
and how can it be said that they have no shepherd,
it can be said,
that the inner drawing down through the shepherd is the study of Torah,79
and since the Torah of now is mere breath compared to the Torah of Moshiach,80
it follows that the true aspect of the shepherd
(innermost) is still lacking.
And although the discussion here is after "Elokim will save Tzion and build the cities of Yehudah etc.," which will be in the future redemption,
behold, the primary revelation that will be in the future redemption is the revelation of the Essence of Ein Sof, which is beyond comprehension,
and this was Dovid's request
(Dovid, King Moshiach),
and through his request this was accomplished,
that there will also be the matter of the shepherd,
the understanding and comprehension of Torah in ultimate perfection.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: The connection between Hashem's choice of Israel and Israel's choice of Hashem is explained, showing that the former empowers the latter, and this power is drawn through the sacrifices of Asher and the teachings of the Alter Rebbe and Tzemach Tzedek, leading to the ultimate redemption.
section.t: C)
And based on all the above, we can explain the connection and relationship of Israel's choice of Hashem and Hashem's choice of Israel,
that Hashem's choice of Israel to be for Him a treasured people,
that His innermost will is in Israel
(and not that they are a means for something else),
is the root and enabling power for Israel's choice of Hashem,
as explained at length above, that Israel's choice of Hashem is because their root is in the innermost aspect of the will.
[And it can be said,
that from the fact that the choice is in Israel in the body,
from this they draw the power,
that even in physical matters there will be the revelation of the innermost aspect of the will,
through which it is felt in them that even physicality is for the sake of the service of G-d.]
And based on this we can explain that the sacrifices of Asher, which were on account of the choice that Hashem chose Israel,
even though the validation of Israel is only because they chose Hashem,
for the primary elevation of Israel is
(not what they possess from above,
but rather)
what they effect through their service,
and specifically in this
(what they effect through their service)
is the primary gratification and delight of Hashem,
except that in order for them to have the enabling power for this, it is through the drawing down and revelation of Hashem's choice of Israel,
and this revelation is drawn through the sacrifices that Asher offered.
For in addition to the power that each Jew has from his root in the innermost aspect of the will,
behold, through the sacrifices of Asher,
this power is drawn in greater revelation.
And it can be said that through the Alter Rebbe's statement, "I want nothing more than You alone,"
and especially after this was publicized by the Tzemach Tzedek,
the power was given
(even more)
to each and every Jew,
and especially to those who follow in his footsteps and ways,
that even though he has many desires,
even desires stemming from the Nefesh HaBahamis,
all his desires will be without a divided heart,
and his primary desire will be to complete the intention of the Essence to make for Him a dwelling place in the lower realms
(in a manner similar to the Alter Rebbe, who wanted nothing more than You alone),
and even his desire for physicality will be
(primarily)
in order to make the physical into a vessel for G-dliness.
And through this, abundant physical bounty will also be drawn to him,
as the Alter Rebbe said:81
"When the Almighty gives Jews physicality, and Jews make from the physicality spirituality,"
from which it is understood,
that when Hashem gives Israel abundant physicality, Israel make abundant spirituality,
abundance in quantity and abundance in quality,
until ultimate perfection,
until they are bound and united with Hashem,
Israel
(Torah)
and the Holy One, blessed be He, are all one.82
And all this is done with joy and a good heart,
in the days of preparation for the time of our freedom,
and this also brings about the time of our freedom in actuality,
the true and complete redemption through our righteous Moshiach,
very soon.
